in_sanskrit.name: Bapurao
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Father of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bapurao एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Lord Bapurao is a name given to Lord Ganesha, who is considered the God of Wisdom and the remover of obstacles. The name 'Bapurao' signifies the father of wealth, and it is believed that invoking this name brings prosperity and abundance in one's life.
